name: Pension Murnau
beschreibung: Pension Murnau is located in the center of Thiersee, a quiet village in the Tiroler Unterland near the Bavarian border. The house is run as a traditional inn and offers cozy rooms with wooden elements. Guests can enjoy simple Tiroler Küche and direct access to the leisure activities in the valley, including hiking trails and the Thiersee itself.
